title: Facile synthesis of an α-Fe2O3–TiO2-MXene heterojunction for enhanced acetone gas sensors
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,3040-3046
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08407A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zhenyuan Yang, Ying Chen
The α-Fe2O3–TiO2-MXene heterojunction improved the electron-transfer efficiency and provided many active sites for gas-sensitive reactions. A gas sensor based on it showed 24 to 50 ppm acetone with a response/recovery time of 10 s/6 s.
